sql: SELECT "TV_series"."Channel" AS e, "TV_Channel"."Language" AS g, AVG((CAST(("TV_series"."Share" - "TV_series"."Rating") AS REAL) / "TV_series"."Rating")) AS m1 FROM "TV_series" JOIN "TV_Channel" ON "TV_Channel"."id" = "TV_series"."Channel"  GROUP BY "TV_series"."Channel", "TV_Channel"."Language" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: TV_series.relative difference of household audience share from household rating
why: (household audience share - household rating) / household rating: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of household audience share from household rating per TV_Channel within TV_Channel.Language
